messages:
Amanda: Quick follow-up from the fused-attention RFC — we need to lock the operator ABI so the runtime can reliably select fused kernels and graceful fallback paths.

Raj: Strong +1 to separating the kernel ABI from scheduling policy. If we mix them we get N*M combos.

Kyle: Proposal: kernel_descriptor fields = layout:{interleaved|separated}, fused_qkv:{true|false}, fused_bias_rope:{true|false}, dropoutless:{true|false}, quant:{int8|fp16|fp32}, abi_version:"1.0". Runtime should match exact descriptor first, then try transforms.

Sophie: Concern: tensor transforms to match kernel layout can add latency for short seqs. Need cost model/thresholds. :thinking: 

Amanda: Right — heuristic: if transform_cost < token_cost*0.2 then do transform; else choose unfused kernel or route to model variant.

Raj: Can we represent kernel capabilities as a bitmask so selector can do fast bit operations? Bitset intersection is cheap.

Kyle: selector pseudocode:
```
for k in kernels:
  if (k.bitmask & request.bitmask) == request.bitmask:
    return k
# no exact match
if cheap_transform():
  transform_tensors_on_device()
  return transformed_kernel
else:
  return unfused_kernel
```

Maria: For quantized kernels, QKV ordering often differs. Propose a tiny device-side reorder kernel fused with transpose to avoid host roundtrips/copies. Keep it in the kernel catalog as a transform primitive.

Sophie: That helps perf but increases maintenance. Longer-term alternative: make model exporter emit a canonical QKV order so kernels assume one layout.

Amanda: Agreed. Long-term refactor = push canonicalization into compiler/exporter. Short-term = selector + on-device reorder microkernels.

Raj: Also add abi_version to kernel descriptors and guard upgrades. We must keep backward compatibility for existing dedicated deployments.

Kyle: Edge case: dropoutless path must preserve deterministic semantics. For inference we disable dropout, but some fused codepaths expect a mask tensor. Ensure dropoutless kernels are explicit and don't read uninitialized memory.

Sophie: And we need telemetry: record kernel_id, transform_time_ms, and fallback_reason per request so we can tune thresholds and see regression.

Amanda: Action items: @Kyle prototype selector, @Raj add bitmask+abi to kernel spec, @Sophie add perf tests to harness. I'll update the RFC draft with the ABI sketch and perf thresholds and send a PR by EOD.
